h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thoothukudi

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Thoothukudi

items.pText: Thoothukudi is a port city with salt pans along its coast, and both put salt into the air that settles on anything left outdoors. Bare steel near the sea starts to rust quickly here. FunPlay Systems builds outdoor playground equipment for schools, port and industrial colonies, and parks in Thoothukudi at our factory in Vasai East, about 1,310 km away.

The city is hot and fairly dry for most of the year, with most of its rain from October to December. The finished pieces reach Thoothukudi by road, and our own team or a south Indian dealer installs them. Tell us how far your site is from the sea and send a few photos. We will pick materials and a layout to suit, with the safe play area marked on the drawing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Choosing parts that stand up to salt

c: The more of a structure that is roto-moulded plastic, the less there is to corrode. Slides, panels and roofs in plastic are unaffected by salt. Steel posts and frames should be galvanised, and any scratch in that coating should be touched up quickly. Nuts and bolts are the parts to watch, so ask us at handover which ones to check.

Hose the equipment down with fresh water every few weeks, and again after a windy spell, to wash off salt and dust. Avoid a spot where spray or dust from the salt pans blows in directly. A wall or hedge on the sea side helps. Ask us to suggest pieces with fewer exposed steel parts. See also

items.q: Does salt air damage playground equipment in Thoothukudi?
items.a: Salt attacks bare steel. Galvanised posts and roto-moulded plastic parts hold up much better, and a fresh-water rinse every few weeks keeps salt from building up on the joints.

items.q: Which parts should we check most often near the sea?
items.a: Nuts, bolts and any place where the galvanised coating is scratched. We explain which fixings to check at handover. Springs and bearings carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects.
Yes. The equipment travels by road from our factory in Vasai East, about 1,310 km away, and our installation team or a dealer in south India installs it.
